note: [L]'s Curve fixes addresses and tests, makes coupling and vacuum scalar continuous, and requires that for every ε>0, near each point, majorants exist whose weighted sums over all addresses are at most ε. This is [M]'s convergence to zero of the two weighted sums, stated with ε.

def deviation (P : BudgetPoint) (U V : Activities G n) (δ : ℝ) :=
    ∃ c d : ℕ → ℝ,
    (∀ i, variesRegular P (U.reg i) (U.E i) (V.E i) (c i)) ∧
    (∀ i, 0 ≤ d i ∧ ∀ x, ‖U.K i x - V.K i x‖ ≤ d i) ∧
    SumBudget (fun i => P.mass (U.reg i).support (c i)) δ ∧
    SumBudget (fun i => P.mass (U.forced i).support (d i)) δ
